idea-plugin.name: Bun Actions on Save
idea-plugin.description:
Format and lint supported files with Bun as you work. Bun actions appear directly in the IDE's native Actions on Save settings.

  • Run bun fmt to format selected file types.
  • Run bun lint --fix to lint selected file types and apply safe fixes.
  • Optionally show Bun lint warnings and errors in the editor while you edit, independently of lint fixes on save.
  • Choose file types independently for formatting and linting.
  • Use automatic configuration to run Bun from PATH, or manual configuration to select a Bun executable.
  • Enable or disable formatting and linting separately, or disable Bun actions entirely.

Configure the plugin in Settings | Tools | Bun. The Actions on Save entries stay in sync with the selected configuration.
